examples.en: Ralph tapped me on the shoulder.
examples.zh: 拉尔夫轻轻地拍了拍我的肩膀。

examples.en: Ralph was luxuriating in the first real holiday he'd had in years.
examples.zh: 拉尔夫那时正在尽情享受多年来的第一次真正假期。

examples.en: "We can cause the lightning to strike where we want it to using rockets," says Ralph Bernstein, manager of lightning projects at EPRI.
examples.zh: 美国电力研究协会（EPRI）负责闪电项目的经理拉尔夫·伯恩斯坦说：“我们可以用火箭让闪电打到我们想要的地方。”
